reason: Document B's bottom-line request—posting a firm installation date in the lobby—is so simple and reasonable that I would look foolish on local TV if I refused it, and pointing out that two-thirds of the households signed the petition makes it hard to dismiss them as just a few loud people. Document A's long list of invasive demands, like handing over supplier names and engineering assessments, just makes me defensive and confirms my view of the association as unreasonable.
